prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG player-worn energy barrier overlay for a Japanese anime bullet-hell game. This is a VFX sprite that is drawn around the live animated player character, NOT a collectible icon.
Primary request: a beautiful translucent protective force-field bubble that visibly envelops the entire player from head to feet. Render ONLY the empty barrier, no character inside. A clean slightly tall oval, close to a sphere, with a luminous icy-white and pale mint-cyan glass rim; broad elegant crescent reflections hugging the left and right silhouette, a few restrained hexagonal glass facets along the OUTERMOST sides, and one slim curved elliptical energy sweep around the lower perimeter that suggests a three-dimensional protective shell. Painterly polished anime game VFX, delicate but immediately readable at 48 pixels tall. Restrained bright silver-white highlights, no large sparkles.
Composition/framing: one centered upright oval, width about 78% of canvas and height about 86%, fully contained with clear transparent margins. Square canvas. Left/right rim and top/bottom arcs form a protective cocoon. All visual information concentrated near the rim.
Transparency: actual transparent alpha background, including the empty interior. The central 60% must be completely transparent so a character and tiny collision dot underneath stay perfectly visible. Only the rim/facets/reflections have opacity, with soft translucent cyan edging. No solid interior color, no black matte, no checkerboard baked into pixels.
Avoid: no shield crest, no handheld shield, no diamond gem, no badge, no icon plate, no robot or person, no scenery, no floor, no text, no UI, no labels, no rays across the center, no starbursts, no particle cloud, no purple, no opaque colored disk.
